start_combat_encounter_entities.description: Roll Initiative and establish an encounter between two canonical creature states. When combat is inactive and the player declares a hostile weapon attack against a known present creature, including a companion, you MUST call this operation before any player-facing prose and before resolving the attack, then follow the freshly exposed combat lifecycle and weapon-attack operations. Do not decide in prose that the attack misses, is deflected, or is de-escalated. Do not restate the scene or ask what the player does instead. Do not substitute an Athletics or other skill check for the attack. Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation. Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.
